description: A strip marker removes a space written as a \u0020 escape sequence
notes: The spec doesn't say whether a quoted template's escape sequences are decoded before strip markers apply; if stripping looked at the source text, the escape \u0020 would not be a space. hashicorp/hcl decodes first: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls ParseStringLiteralToken, which decodes escapes, before it trims the literal.
